address.title: Token contract address
address.description: The community token whose holding is being weighed. Any standard ERC-20; unlike a share token it is not required to expose uiMultiplier().

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Token decimals. Controls formatting only; the integration itself is done in wei.

windowSeconds.title: Window length (seconds)
windowSeconds.description: How long each ballot in this space stays open. The weighing window is [proposal block, proposal block + this], so a closed ballot's weights never move again. Publish ballots with end = start + this value.
